name: ks-transfer-pricing
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Kansas transfer pricing and related-party adjustments for tax year 2026: Kansas has no standalone TP documentation regime; related-party exposure runs through combined reporting, intangible/management-fee addbacks, and the apportionment base. Trigger on "Kansas transfer pricing", "Kansas combined report", "Kansas related party", "Kansas addback", "Kansas unitary". Source-cited draft; consolidated-return and allocation-authority rules cited to archived statutes; addback rules not yet confirmed.
